title: Installation Jobs: Short-Notice Multiplier for Company Date Moves
content:
**Short-notice multiplier — company reschedules on Installation Jobs**

The shorter the notice Ridgeline gave when it moved or released a crew date on an **Installation Jobs** record, the larger the credit. The notice is the whole hours before 08:00 on the booked crew date recorded on the most recent company reschedule of the job, and it multiplies the move credit itself:

| Notice given by Ridgeline | Move credit |
|---|---|
| fewer than 24 hours | doubled (multiplied by 2) |
| 24 to fewer than 36 hours | multiplied by 1.5 |
| 36 hours or more | taken once |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, move credit 100.00)

| Hours of notice | Multiplier | Move credit after notice |
|---|---|---|
| 23 | 2 | 200.00 |
| 24 | 1.5 | 150.00 |
| 35 | 1.5 | 150.00 |
| 36 | one | 100.00 |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

Ridgeline moved a crew date with 30 whole hours of notice, and the move credit for that move is 120.00. The notice falls in the band of 24 to fewer than 36 hours, so the move credit is multiplied by 1.5, giving 180.00.

The multiplier applies to the move credit only; it is read from the notice recorded on the company reschedule itself, not from any customer reschedule of the job.
